codes.description: Object fails its declared JSON Schema.
Schema version is unsupported or ambiguous.
Required referenced object cannot be resolved.
Resolved reference is of the wrong canonical object type.
Stored hash differs from canonical recomputation.
Required canonical hash algorithm is unsupported.
Referenced version is missing or resolves to more than one immutable object.
A required fact is UNKNOWN, UNVERIFIED, unresolved, or otherwise non-passable.
Campaign binding hash does not match the canonical campaign.
Registered campaign semantics were changed in place.
Research, validation, and OOS ranges overlap or are not strictly ordered.
Campaign asset classes are incompatible with one or more bound models.
Canonical research lacks a preregistration.
Preregistration hash does not match canonical content.
Preregistration is bound to a different campaign/hash.
Registered preregistration was changed in place.
Experiment strategy family was not allowed by preregistration.
Experiment uses a feature not allowed by preregistration.
Experiment uses a label not allowed by preregistration.
Parameter value or parameter key violates preregistered search space.
Data binding is not fully PIT certified.
Required market-data certification cannot be resolved.
Dataset manifest hash differs from bound immutable snapshot.
One or more source snapshot hashes differ from the bound data.
Qualification run used a dirty/uncommitted working tree.
Executed code differs from the bound commit/tree/dependency state.
Runtime environment differs from the bound environment.
Campaign-required determinism level is not met.
Feature definition/version cannot be resolved.
Feature definition hash does not match the bound version.
Same feature ID/version was reused for changed semantics.
Feature input was not knowable by the decision information cutoff.
Label definition/version cannot be resolved.
Label definition hash does not match the bound version.
Label or forward outcome information leaked into model inputs.
Cross-validation fold timestamps are not temporally valid.
Training and validation sets overlap where not explicitly allowed.
Purging does not meet label horizon/preregistered requirement.
Embargo does not meet label horizon/preregistered requirement.
Temporal research attempted shuffled CV without an approved exception.
Experiment provenance cannot be reconstructed completely.
Experiment campaign binding is inconsistent.
Experiment preregistration binding is inconsistent.
Experiment consumed data outside the phase's authorized date range.
Experiment sequence is duplicated or non-deterministically assigned.
Search-ledger counts do not reconcile to registered experiments.
Canonical campaign experiment is missing from the search ledger.
Search ledger references an unknown experiment.
Required execution model cannot be resolved.
Execution model does not support the campaign/instrument asset class.
Required lifecycle event handling is absent or bypassed.
No valid cost model is bound.
Cost model is outside its declared effective interval.
Cost model does not support the relevant asset class.
Research implicitly or silently defaulted total transaction costs to zero.
Information known_from exceeds decision information cutoff.
signal_time is later than decision_time.
decision_time is later than order_time.
order_time is later than fill execution_time.
receipt_time is earlier than known_from under a source model that forbids it.
Aggregate fill quantity exceeds executable order quantity.
Fill lacks a resolvable market state snapshot.
Campaign requires locked OOS but no valid lock exists.
OOS outcome data was accessed without valid EQS-00 authorization.
Authorization does not match campaign/candidate/hash/scope.
Append-only OOS access log cannot be proven continuous.
OOS execution candidate hash differs from the authorized sealed candidate.
A compromised OOS interval was treated as clean by relocking it.
Candidate-specific OOS outcomes were read before candidate sealing.
OOS qualification attempted without a SEALED candidate.
Candidate hash does not recompute from all frozen dependencies.
Frozen candidate semantics changed after sealing.
Candidate changed after OOS was opened.
Candidate research evidence manifest does not match its frozen hash.
A preregistered required stress test is absent.
Stress test baseline does not match the sealed candidate baseline.
Required stress evidence is inconclusive.
Required reproduction evidence is missing.
Research result failed its declared reproducibility tolerance.
Metric observation does not match the registered metric definition/version/hash.
Required qualification metric has insufficient data.
Handoff candidate identity/hash differs from OOS-consumed candidate.
Handoff campaign identity/hash is inconsistent.
Handoff preregistration identity/hash is inconsistent.
Required sealed OOS evidence is absent.
Handoff search-ledger hash differs from canonical ledger.
Handoff stress evidence hash differs from canonical evidence.
Research evidence is not eligible for a valid PAPER handoff.
Research Infrastructure attempted to self-authorize PAPER or LIVE.
